meals.title: Boerewors Braai with Pap and Tomato Smoor
meals.why: Boerewors is on special at Checkers (R89.99/kg with loyalty card), and a 10kg bag of maize meal makes the pap very cheap.
method: Light the fire and braai the wors over medium coals for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Fry a chopped onion and garlic in a little oil until soft. Add the chopped tomatoes, salt and a pinch of chilli, and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Bring 4 cups of salted water to the boil. Stir in about 2 cups of maize meal, cover and cook on low for 20-25 minutes, stirring now and then, until crumbly.
Serve the wors with the pap, the tomato smoor and a spoonful of chutney.

meals.title: Spiced Butternut and Bean Stew over Rice
meals.why: Butternut is only R14.99/kg, and canned beans and tomatoes stretch it into a filling vegetarian meal for very little money.

uses.item: Koo Baked Beans In Tomato Sauce 400g

method: Peel the butternut and cut it into 2cm cubes.
Fry a chopped onion and garlic in oil. Add 2 tsp paprika and 1 tsp curry powder or cumin, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the butternut, chopped tomatoes and half a can of water. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the butternut is tender.
Stir in the baked beans and heat through for 5 minutes. Season to taste.
Cook the rice according to the packet and serve the stew on top.

meals.title: Chicken Livers in Spicy Tomato Sauce on Toast
meals.why: At R21.50 for 500g, frozen chicken livers are one of the cheapest proteins on special, and they cook in minutes.
method: Thaw the livers in the fridge during the day, then drain and pat dry.
Fry a sliced onion and garlic in oil for 5 minutes. Add the livers and brown for 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, 1 tsp paprika, chilli, salt and 1/2 cup water. Simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce is thick and the livers are cooked through.
Toast the bread and serve the livers on top.

meals.title: Butternut-Topped Cottage Pie
meals.why: Lean mince is on special at PnP (R99.99), and a butternut mash topping is cheaper than potato.

uses.item: PnP Live Well Bulk Lean Beef Mince

method: Heat the oven to 190°C. Peel and cube the butternut, then boil for 15 minutes until soft. Mash with a knob of Stork and season.
Brown the mince with onion and garlic, breaking up any lumps.
Add the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, diced carrot or peas, mixed herbs and seasoning. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Spoon the mince into an ovenproof dish and cover with the mash. Rough up the top with a fork and add cheese if using.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

meals.title: Glazed Pork Braai Chops with Oven Fries and Cucumber Salad
meals.why: Pork braai chops are R64.99 and chutney makes an easy glaze. Fries and cucumber are both on special, so the whole plate is on promo.
method: Season the chops with salt and pepper. Mix 3 tbsp chutney with a splash of vinegar or lemon juice and brush it over the chops.
Put the fries in the oven at 220°C for about 20 minutes, turning halfway.
Braai or pan-grill the chops for 5-6 minutes per side, brushing with more glaze and watching for burning.
Slice the cucumber and toss with vinegar, salt and a little red onion.
Rest the chops for 3 minutes and serve with the fries and salad.

meals.title: Tuna Egg Rice Bowl with Cucumber
meals.why: Cheap shredded tuna and eggs on rice make a quick, protein-rich dinner using store cupboard items on special.

uses.item: No Name Live Well Shredded Tuna in Salt Water 170g

method: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Drain the tuna and mix with 2-3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, chopped onion and pepper.
Slice the cucumber and halve the eggs.
Serve the rice topped with the tuna mix, eggs and cucumber, with a dash of soy sauce if you like.
